profile.description: 2026 review corrected: adult/21+ events are valid Adventure Zone prospects and must not be rejected solely because of age restriction or alcohol service. Gate City Oktoberfest is Sept. 26, 2026 at Lookout Point in Historic Downtown Pocatello, with beer/cider tasting, food and live music. Warrior's Playground may be a natural adult-oriented angle. Verify space, hours, route economics and package availability before deciding outreach.

notes.subject: Correction — adult/21+ is not a non-fit reason
notes.body: Do not reject this event because it is adult/beer-focused. Adventure Zone can work adult events. Consider Warrior's Playground and competitive/adrenaline attractions as the primary angle, then evaluate footprint, operating hours, route economics, organizer interest and availability.
